definitions.gloss: to teach and guide; to mentor; to lead and instruct
definitions.explanation: To both teach knowledge and guide someone in the right direction. Implies a deeper, more personal form of education than simply teaching facts. Often used for mentoring, parenting, and spiritual guidance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{教|おし}え{導|みちび}く。
⟦{恩師|おんし}→恩師：12598_onshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{教|おし}え{導|みちび}かれて⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I am who I am today because my mentor taught and guided me.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{教|おし}え{導|みちび}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧だ。
examples.english: It is the responsibility of adults to teach and guide the younger generation in the right direction.

notes:
FORMS:
Compound verb: ⟦{教|おし}える→教える：00526_oshieru⟧ (to teach) + ⟦{導|みちび}く→導く：12361_michibiku⟧ (to lead/guide). The combination emphasizes both the instructional and directional aspects of guidance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{教|おし}え{導|みちび}く (to teach and guide children)
- ⟦{正|ただ}しく→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧{教|おし}え{導|みちび}く (to guide correctly)
- {教|おし}え{導|みちび}く⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧ (a position of mentoring)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to instruct, to coach — more formal and institutional
- ⟦{導|みちび}く→導く：12361_michibiku⟧: to guide, to lead — emphasis on direction rather than teaching
- ⟦{諭|さと}す→諭す：14223_satosu⟧: to admonish gently, to counsel — emphasis on moral persuasion
